body:
You're right: `tag_size_cache` is `0`, if no tags.
But this must be taken into account when setting `tag_maxsize`.
`tag_maxsize` is used to set the minimum size the project title can be, therefore it cannot be zero. Also your code changes only work when there are no tags. If tags are added it breaks when resizing

This is the crucial point (or line): Now `title_size_cache` is actually calculated, istead of using a hard-coded value like 800 * EDSCALE.
(I calculated the new "hard-coded value" (144 * EDSCALE) by measuring pixels using GIMP. It may be quite accurate.)
